notes.title: Update for testers
notes.notes:
Small update with new content for testers.
If you want to try out these new changes, make sure you select the test_branch in betas section on steam.

here is a blatantly copied list of patch notes:

-Fixed price reduction upgrades increase the price instead of reduce it
-Added auto collect xp upgrade
-Added auto consume xp upgrade
-Added 2x mining speed xp upgrade
-Added toggles for xp upgrades

notes.title: RELEASE IS HERE!
notes.notes:
[b][h1]IT IS TIME![/h1][/b]

[h2][b]Release is here :)[/b][/h2]
[h3]First off, I want to thank all the people who helped me getting the game stable.
For the people who first stumble upon my game now, feel free to try it out.
It is a small and short gaming experience but it keeps you hooked.
I am going to stop talking now, enjoy the release for those who waited![/h3]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some visual fixes
[*] Added a beta branch for people who want to try the new things the first time they come out. (Will be wiped often)
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes and precautions
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Bug fixes and precautions[/b][/h1]
Again wipe is recommended to play the game with all the right parameters

Here are blatantly copied, as always, patch notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed pc un-equipping when equipping booster
[*] Fixed last achievement triggering in normal instead of hell
[*] Fixed needing to equip a pc 2 times in order to equip the pc
[*] Removed level up button for nut when nut is max level
[*] Moved more from background loop to main loop to solve ObjDelErr (auto buying, course)
[*] Max buys now buy instantly (precautions against other bugs, also, it is faster)
[/list]

notes.title: Fixes and DB changes
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Fixes and DB changes[/h1][/b]
Here are blatantle copied patch notes once again:

[list]
[*] Fixed achievement popups
[*] Nerfed Nut speed a tiny weeny bit
[*] Moved buy xp upgrade function from view to controller
[*] Critical change only happens after update
[*] Added minimum for buy value when upgrading price reduction for pcs
[*] Added notification icon for when a nut is ready in the tree
[*] Fixed list.remove(x) error (bandaid, origin is still unknown)
[*] Added another potential fix for ObjectDeletedErrors or stale states in background loop
[*] Added a function logger that logs previous run functions if there is a crash
[*] Exe builder now quits steam and reopens after
[/list]
